allOf.description: 1.2.0 keeps exactly its original meaning: C2C is unavailable and every record is a single write. Only a 1.3.0 request may turn C2C on or reprogram more than once.
C2C on: every referenced profile revision must state its own manual relative CV -- never inherited or copied from another profile in the same request.
C2C off: no profile_refs entry may carry manual C2C data (it must not look pre-filled), and a single write is required.

ExperimentRequest.description: Validated request shape; server must also enforce published profile/data/engine capabilities and run budget. No measured device fields may be overridden. v1.1.0 requests are not reinterpreted: tile_size is now explicit with the ADC off and adc_order is required, so a 1.1.0 request is rejected with an explicit migration error. v1.2.0 requests keep their original meaning (C2C unavailable, single write). v1.3.0 adds an optional manual-assumption C2C model per docs/completion-plan-2026-09-21.md P2: relative CV in percent per referenced profile revision, plus 1-100 reprogram iterations; off (the default reading of a 1.2.0 request) is unchanged.

c2c.description: Manual engineering assumption (not a measured CTFM distribution): relative CV as a percent, converted to a ratio exactly once at this boundary (ctfm.simulation.math.c2c_relative_cv_percent_to_ratio).
